description: This file contains shell functions for managing U-Boot environment variables using UCI configuration system. It defines functions to add U-Boot environment configurations and interact with UCI's batch mode.

methods.name: _ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Internal function to add U-Boot environment configuration to UCI based on provided parameters.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Wrapper around _ubootenv_add_uci_config to specify 'ubootenv' configuration type.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_sys_config
methods.description: Wrapper around _ubootenv_add_uci_config to specify 'ubootsys' configuration type.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_app_config
methods.description: Configures U-Boot environment with parameters retrieved via config_get and appends to a configuration file if not already present.
